title: 0241 - THE 24-BLOCK MISSING-NOTE MASK is real but weak (holdout +0.0120 nats/block, z = +94.9, fit-first-half/score-second), and THE STICK (P(x) = sum of primes, N(x) = sum of non-primes) is measured NULL: modular shadow corr +0.0126 (prime positions) vs -0.0134 (odd null), far-pointer MR primality of the odd neighbor of P(x_k) (y ~ 1e8..3e14) uncorrelated with the local forward distance (z = -0.395), the movie-pair (P,N) flat, the two guides uncorrelated (r = +0.0081). The owner's absence-sharpens-future intuition is confirmed in ROW form (0240) but does NOT extend to global additive pointers at this resolution. No RH claim
body: LOOM21 (scripts/sq/loom21_harmony_stick.py, tmp/loom/loom21_out.txt), X = 1e8, prompted by the owner's 2026-10-31 idea ('the calculation might be HELPED by the absence of primes before the current integer... every 24-period we drop one... a stick like the sum of all primes to this point points WAY far off... maybe the other pointer is the sum of the non-primes... the sums might need to include the missing primes'). INSTRUMENT A - 24-block harmony mask: for each of the 4,162,499 blocks [24k, 24k+24) with 24k >= 1e5, the 8-bit mask of which classes {1,5,7,11,13,17,19,23} are realized by a prime inside the block (227 of 256 masks occur; ZERO full-harmony blocks - 8 primes in one 24-period never happens to 1e8; mean 1.382 realized notes per period, 6.618 missing). Forward gap d = next prime after the block end. HOLDOUT (fit P(d bucket | mask) on the first 2,081,249 blocks, score the last 2,081,250): PRIOR(h) 2.34925, MASK(h) 2.33721, gain = +0.01204 nats/block vs the shuffle-null -0.04093 +/- 0.00056 -> z = +94.9: real but small - the per-period missing-note CHORD carries far less than the prime's exact position within the period (0240's row form, +0.5555 holdout at the prime level). The raw point-biserial (missing-notes vs d <= 7, r = +0.0374) and lag-1 dropcount autocorrelation (-0.0364) are density-drift confounded (both trend with x over [1e5, 1e8]) and are NOT the headline. INSTRUMENT B - the stick: P(x) = sum of primes <= x (the FULL sum - 'includes the missing primes in the total' by construction), N(x) = x(x+1)/2 - P(x) (the other pointer). Subsample 8192 primes x_k spread over [5e4, 1e8], P up to 2.792e14 (MR cross-verified against trial division on reconstructed values: agreement). (i) MODULAR GUIDE: corr(P(x_k) mod 24, forward-distance top-quartile indicator) = +0.0126 at prime positions vs -0.0134 at 8192 random odd positions - SE ~ 1/90 = 0.011: the prime-position value is ~1.1 sigma, the prime-vs-odd difference ~1.7 sigma: NOT confirmable (null). (ii) FAR POINTER: Miller-Rabin (deterministic 12-base set, y < 3.3e24) on the odd-neighbor of P(x_k): P(prime) = 0.0634 (consistent with 1/ln(y) averaged over y in [1e8, 3e14]); local forward top-quartile share 0.2601 (stick-prime) vs 0.2698 (stick-composite), lift -0.00291 vs null -0.00082 +/- 0.00529 -> z = -0.395: NULL. (iii) MOVIE PAIR: (MR(oddP), MR(oddN)) joint table vs the local top quartile is flat (0.268-0.296; the both-prime n = 33 cell is 0.0606 = noise); corr(stickP prime, stickN prime) = +0.0081: the two guides are uncorrelated to each other. CONCLUSION: the global additive invariants (prime sum / non-prime sum) do not steer the local tape at 1e8 resolution - the 'stick pointing way far off' is not a guide at this scale; the confirmed absence-sharpens-future mechanism is the LOCAL/JOINT support row (0240), which is exactly the theorem-side structure now in LoomWheel.lean. Negative result reported per discipline. All off-board, no RH claim.
